Lean toolchain: leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0 (matches this repository)

Copies of src/lean/ZrAsm/{Isa,Print,Dsl}.lean. These are the
instruction AST, assembly printer and construction DSL only. No Zynq board
initialization, router runtime, drivers or other bootloader was imported.
No standalone license notice was found in these files or at the source
repository root; this file does not assign a new license or grant public
redistribution permission. Preserve upstream notices if later supplied.

Local patch: Isa/Print add only typed LDRH, STRH and SMC instruction cases
and their assembly rendering. Dsl is unchanged. These are required for the
G13 MIU pipe's 16-bit registers and the exact secure-monitor handoff.
Original SHA256:

Patched hashes are pinned in tools/bootloader/build.py and build.json.

The upstream loadSym documentation uses the phrase position independent,
but MOVW/MOVT symbol halves are absolute after linking. This probe does not
use loadSym. Its relocatability is checked on the final linked bytes.
